diffs.diff: physical layout: the board has 2 header rows, but this small module is modelled as plugging in as a single row
diffs.evidence: The two rows are duplicates, not separate signals: the Adafruit guide says 'In the center of the board, on each edge, are a set of six through-hole pads' followed by a single VIN/GND/SCL/SDA/INT/UPDI list, and the official Eagle schematic wires both 1x6 headers JP1 and JP5 to the same nets pin for pin (UPDI net: '<pinref part="JP5" gate="A" pin="6"/>' next to '<pinref part="JP1" gate="A" pin="6"/>'), so one 1x6 header on either edge carries every signal and the single-row 1x6 model is correct.
